summary: Full backend + frontend testing of TradeHub. Backend: 25/25 pytest cases passed covering auth (login, /me, invalid creds), strategies CRUD + computed metrics + webhook_url, all 3 webhook approval modes (auto_execute, require_approval, auto_approve_timer with 2s wait), alert approve/reject, trades CRUD with PnL math verified for long/short/options multiplier, tags CRUD, all analytics endpoints (overview, equity-curve, calendar, by/{symbol|strategy|tag|side}, mfe-mae, time-of-day, strategy-comparison), bot status + mode toggle, and settings get/put. Frontend: login → dashboard with stat cards + cumulative equity chart + Approval Center (2 seeded pending alerts) + recent alerts. All 6 sidebar nav links navigate correctly. Strategies page lists cards, create-strategy dialog saves and card count increased (0 visible initially → 4 after refresh; previously seeded 3 + new TEST_UI_Strat). Strategy detail page loads on card click. Journal lists 120+ trades, Add Trade dialog creates trade and it appears (124 rows after add), clicking row opens trade-detail-dialog. Analysis page – all 5 tabs (Calendar, Equity & Drawdown, Breakdowns, MFE/MAE, Strategy Compare) render with SVG charts/tables. Notifications page Settings tab renders and Save works. Bot page renders with paper/live status text. Theme toggle works.

issues: Missing aria-describedby on Radix DialogContent – console warnings (accessibility nit, not blocking)

action_items: OPTIONAL: Add data-testid attributes on Analysis tabs that currently lack them: tab-equity, tab-breakdown, tab-mfe (only tab-calendar and tab-strategies are present). Tabs functionally work and were verified via role=tab+name. Problem statement mentioned tab-calendar etc., so consider adding the rest for testability consistency.
OPTIONAL: Add data-testid for Bot mode toggle button (none found in DOM; functionality not blocked, page still renders and POST /api/bot/mode works in API).
OPTIONAL: Add DialogDescription / aria-describedby to all DialogContent components to clear Radix accessibility warnings.

OPTIONAL: Cleanup test data left over from UI test run: a strategy named 'TEST_UI_Strat' and a trade with symbol 'UITEST' remain in DB. Also 4 TEST_WH_* webhook strategies were created+deleted by API tests (deleted).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 885 lines – consider splitting into modules (auth, strategies, webhooks, trades, analytics, notifications) for maintainability.

execute_alert(): early-return logic for missing/invalid status is ambiguous (`if not alert or alert['status'] not in ('pending','approved'): if not alert: return`) – it falls through and proceeds when status is invalid but alert exists. Not currently exploitable because callers gate by status, but should be tightened.

auto_approve_timer is registered with asyncio.create_task at webhook time; if backend restarts before timer fires, the alert remains 'pending' forever (no on-startup recovery scan). Not blocking MVP but worth noting.
render_template falls back to f-string only when tpl is empty; missing variables silently render as empty strings.
Settings PUT overwrites all four sub-objects via model_dump (which fills defaults). Partial updates are not supported; OK as documented behaviour but UI should send the full payload (it does).
Filter on /api/trades by start/end is done in Python after Mongo query; fine for current dataset size.
test_credentials: trader@tradehub.io / trade1234 (read from /app/memory/test_credentials.md; matches backend .env ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD)
seed_data_creation: DB is seeded on startup (1 user, 6 tags, 3 strategies, 120 closed trades, 2 pending alerts). My UI test additionally left 1 strategy 'TEST_UI_Strat' and 1 trade 'UITEST' in DB.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest at /app/backend/tests/test_tradehub_api.py is comprehensive – run with: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=<url> pytest backend/tests/test_tradehub_api.py -v. All P&L computation math is asserted (long, short, option *100 multiplier, fees, r_multiple). Webhook tests dynamically create then delete strategies, so they are idempotent. Notification outbound (Telegram/Discord/WhatsApp) is expected to log 'failed' status when credentials are not set – do not flag as bug. IBKR live is MOCKED via paper simulation – also expected.
rca of the issue: No bugs found requiring RCA. Only minor missing data-testid attributes on 3 Analysis tabs and Bot mode toggle, plus accessibility warnings on DialogContent. All functional flows pass.
